ways.label: Around the Mountain Circuit with the high track options
evidence: In the upper car park at North Egmont road end, take the Holly Hut Track left of the Camphouse.

The Around the Mountain Circuit (AMC) can be accessed from several road ends in Te Papa-Kura-o-Taranaki, but traditionally begins at the North Egmont Road end approximately 30 min drive from New Plymouth.
High and lowlevel options exist for some sections, with higher level options recommended for their scenery.
High track: Turn left onto the Puniho Track and walk uphill 1 km to the 6 bunk Kahui Hut.
High track: This area of track is severely eroded in places. Continue past the Taungatara Track along the Brames Falls Track, climbing steeply.

Continue on the Around the Mountain Circuit across tussock slopes to the privately owned Tahurangi Lodge, with the large TV transmitter nearby. From the lodge a 4WD track leads downhill for around 1 hr to North Taranaki Visitor Centre.

ways.label: Around the Mountain Circuit with the low track options
evidence: In the upper car park at North Egmont road end, take the Holly Hut Track left of the Camphouse.
Low track: This section of track is often muddy, eroded and overgrown. It crosses many unbridged streams. Continue along the Kopoaiaia Track past the Kahui track junction and on to the Oaonui Track.
Turn right and follow the Taungatara Track 6 km through bush, until reaching the junction with the Auroa Track. Turn left and ascend the Auroa track 4 km to Mangōraukawa / Lake Dive.
From here follow the Curtis Falls Track for 3 - 4 hr to Maketawa Hut - sections of this track may be overgrown and eroded. From the hut, it's a 1 hr 30 min tramp to North Egmont car park.

doubts: The page offers high and low track options for three sections and does not say which is the main circuit; W1 takes the high options because the text recommends them, W2 the low options, and any mix of the two is also possible. DOC's 52 km matches the section distances with the low final section (8+13+10+9+12), not the high one (8+13+10+15 = 46 km), so the time/distance given on W1 may belong to the low variant. Start ref F1 is the road end on Egmont Road at North Egmont but is named for the North Egmont Summit Track, whereas the walk starts on the Holly Hut Track from the upper car park. The high track ends at 'North Taranaki Visitor Centre', assumed to be the North Egmont start. The text names a 'Taungatara Track' and 'Auroa Track' while the map has 'Taungatara Route' (T19) and 'Auroa Route' (T2), and 'Wilkies Pools Track' while the map has 'Wilkies Pools Loop Track' (T22); taken as the same. Dawson Falls Visitor Centre given as the Dawson Falls place (T28). Tahurangi Lodge is privately owned and its use for staying is not stated, so not listed as a hut; Waingongoro Hut and Maketawa Hut are on the low-option final sections (W2) only. The access points beyond North Egmont are only described as 'several road ends', not named. Direction is not stated.
